title: Career, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: Positions held by Lemi Orhan Ergin since 2001, from Sony to Craftgate, with education, certifications, honors and awards.

blocks.text: I have been writing code since 2001. The orange branches are the two times I left Sony and came back.

items.title: Co-founder & Chief Software Crafter
items.note: A payment orchestration platform that connects online merchants to banks, payment providers and alternative payment methods through one integration.

items.title: Agile Practice Lead & Software Crafter
items.note: Led the cultural transformation of iyzico engineering around agile and lean thinking and software craftsmanship.

items.title: Managing Partner, Master Software Craftsman, Agile Coach & Trainer
items.note: Consulting and training for dozens of companies on agile culture and engineering practices.

items.title: Principal Software Engineer, Technical Lead & Agile Practice Lead
items.note: Also Solution Architect (Dec 2013 – May 2014), then Technical Architect & Scrum Master (May – Dec 2014). Wrote a manifesto for software development at Sony, and organized its Brown Bag Sessions, the weekly trainings colleagues gave each other, along with code retreats and coding dojos.

items.title: MTS1 Software Engineer
items.note: Started GittiGidiyor's move from SVN to Git, set up its central Maven repository, and built its private shopping project from scratch.

items.title: Expert Software Engineer
items.note: Backend services and infrastructure for Sony's marketing websites in the US, Canada and Europe.

items.title: Technical Coordinator & Scrum Master
items.note: Technical lead and people manager of a team of six to seven that built the web services at the centre of Sony Europe's content hub, with shared libraries and backend services.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer
items.note: Support modules for Sony's European marketing websites, and a common toolbar for all of Sony's European sites.

items.title: Software Officer, Second Lieutenant
items.note: In Konya, building military applications on a web framework I designed.

items.title: M.Sc., Computer Engineering
items.text: Marmara University, 2002 – 2005. Thesis: [Example Project: XML Based Content Management Engine](https://web.archive.org/web/20260906174543/https://katalog.marmara.edu.tr/veriler/yordambt/cokluortam/5C/T0052086.pdf), October 2005, advised by Prof. Dr. M. Akif Eyler. A set of open-source Java frameworks for content-heavy web portals, built to work together or alone: JEWEL for page layout, navigation and role-based security, Quarry with JCategorizer for categorized content, and JConfiX for configuration.

items.title: B.Sc., Computer Engineering
items.text: Marmara University, 1997 – 2002. Thesis: a new task-scheduling algorithm in parallel processing, for M-Tasks and S-Tasks in heterogeneous systems.
